name: By Golly
summary: Memory-matching shed game where players match hand animals to hidden farm cards to discard first.
rules_text: Shuffle 19 chicken run cards face down in the center (includes animals, 3 shovels, 2 poos). Shuffle 45 animal cards and deal as evenly as possible to 2-6 players; excess out. Each forms a face-down draw stack and holds 5 cards. On your turn, play one animal from hand face up, then reveal one chicken run card. If they match type, discard your animal(s) - you may discard all copies of that animal from hand at once - leave the run card face up and continue with another animal. If they do not match, take your animal back, flip the run card back down, end turn. If you reveal poo, immediately reveal a second run card: shovel = safe, your turn ends with no discard; animal = take 2 animal cards from chosen opponents into your hand; second poo = take 4 cards from opponents. After a poo you may shuffle any run cards you revealed before flipping them down. End of turn, flip all your revealed run cards face down and draw from your stack to 5 if possible. First to discard all animals wins.
rating_reason: Specific card shedding game, turn-based, strategic
